response.original_title: SCTV: The Greatest Show You’ve Never Heard Of
response.overview: Through intimate interviews with surviving members of its legendary cast and an emotional reunion in Toronto, the film explores the creative partnership that transformed a small Canadian television production into a cultural phenomenon that launched some of comedy’s most celebrated icons.
response.tagline: Chronicling the rise, fall, and enduring legacy of one of the most influential sketch comedy series in television history. “
response.title: SCTV: The Greatest Show You’ve Never Heard Of
